# Asoba Open Source

> Open-source AI infrastructure from Asoba Corporation. Hosted at code.asoba.co.

## nehanda-cli

Agentic AI terminal REPL for governed software development. Deterministic SDLC workflow enforcement, MCP client for tool integration, dynamic tool calling, 4-tier memory compaction, and multi-provider support (Nehanda, Ollama, LM Studio, Anthropic, any OpenAI-compatible API). AGPL-3.0.

Repository: https://github.com/AsobaCloud/nehanda-cli
Documentation: https://code.asoba.co/nehanda-cli

## Nehanda v3

Fine-tuned Qwen3.6-27B for RAG synthesis. Scores 88.7% on FACTS Grounding, surpassing Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and GPT-4o. Trained for ~$135 of GPU time on a single NVIDIA L40S. Open weights.

Model: https://huggingface.co/asoba/nehanda-v3-27b
GGUF: https://huggingface.co/asoba/nehanda-rag-synthesis-27b-gguf
Documentation: https://code.asoba.co/nehanda-model

## MCP Servers

Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers exposing clean energy telemetry and macroeconomic market time series over stdio JSON-RPC.

- **Asoba Platform SDK MCP Server (`asoba[mcp]`):** Inverter telemetry, OODA/JEPA state alerts, KPI rollups, predictive maintenance signals, 90-day task schedules, solar forecasts, and JSON schema resources. Repository: https://github.com/AsobaCloud/sdk
- **Zorora Economic Data MCP Server (`zorora`):** 80 economic & energy market time series spanning FRED, Yahoo Finance, World Bank, Ember Energy, SAPP, and Eskom. Repository: https://github.com/AsobaCloud/zorora
- **Nehanda CLI MCP Integration:** Built-in MCP client engine with automatic namespacing, ODSE energy normalization, and REPL management. Repository: https://github.com/AsobaCloud/nehanda-cli

Documentation: https://code.asoba.co/mcp-servers

## ODS-E

Open Data Schema for Energy — an open specification for interoperable energy asset data.

Specification: https://opendataschema.energy
